As attention moves on from the trial, some researchers want more concrete changes that could improve how postpartum psychosis is researched, treated and prevented. How that happens — and how quickly — is unclear. While some in the mental health community applaud the improvements in how postpartum psychosis is recognized, others think the condition needs a more formal diagnosis for better long-term research. But the overall medical consensus, researchers say, is that postpartum psychosis is treatable when diagnosed early, and that outcomes as severe as Clancy’s are incredibly rare. It’s dedicated to one thing: the attack on America 25 years ago, what it meant then, and what it means now. September 11 was an epochal break, the violent punctuation mark with which one era ended and another began. We have stories on how it changed the world, the war on terror that followed, its contested legacy today, and more. articles.summary: The European Central Bank raised interest rates. Will the Fed follow? Fed-funds traders are putting 64% odds that the Fed will do the same next week (arbitrage alert: the chances on Kalshi are a bit lower ). But the ECB’s only job is to manage inflation, while the Fed has a trickier dual task of managing both prices and employment, and so is keeping an eye on a labor market stuck in a “low hire, low fire” defensive equilibrium. Global central banks would prefer to move their interest rates together to avoid warping investment flows and currency markets. (Back in 1986, a Fed compromise was struck to let Germany and Japan cut first.) articles.summary: A boat on cracked ground at Lake Guija during drought conditions in Metapan, El Salvador, on Sept. 1, 2026. —Camilo Freedman—Getty Images With fall slowly creeping up, experts are warning of a record strong El Niño , colloquially dubbed “super El Niño.” The weather event is expected to impact global temperatures and rainfall, and could increase the risk of extreme weather events in some parts of the world. What is El Niño? El Niño , and its opposite La Niña, are climate patterns that naturally occur in the tropical Pacific. El Niño years tend to see warmer than average waters in the central and eastern Pacific Ocean, while La Niña years are associated with colder than average water temperatures. The corresponding weather events triggered by the warmer ocean can have a varied and strong impact around the globe. With El Niño, forecasters are expecting to see stormier weather in some parts of the world and drought conditions in others. “Pacific sea surface temperatures are going to vary at least two degrees from the average. articles.title: Maryland Under Pressure as Local Moratoriums Supercharge Opposition to Data Centers
articles.author: By Aman Azhar
articles.summary: With Gov. Wes Moore’s reelection less than two months away, Maryland’s environmental community is asking Annapolis to slam the brakes on rapid data center growth and create a statewide policy. By Aman Azhar More than 60 advocacy groups from across Maryland are urging leaders in Annapolis to put a temporary pause on new data center proposals until their impacts on the environment and communities can be fully understood and policies are in place to address any harms.
